description: Illinois income tax withholding for wages paid in 2026 (Booklet IL-700-T automated payroll method).

sources.title: Illinois Department of Revenue, Booklet IL-700-T, Illinois Withholding Tax Tables (2026)
Illinois Department of Employment Security, EA-50, 2026 State Experience Factor and Employers' UI Contribution Rates

incomeTaxWithholding.method: Automated payroll method: 4.95% x (wages - (Line 1 allowances x $2,925 + Line 2 allowances x $1,000) / pay periods per year), plus the IL-W-4 Line 3 additional amount.

cite.ref: How do I calculate the amount to withhold?

unemployment.note: New employer rates include the 0.550% fund building rate. The employer's own rate comes from its IDES notice (entered in Payroll > Setup). An experience-rated employer above 5.400% with quarterly wages under $50,000 pays 5.400% that quarter.

cite.ref: Minimum and maximum rates; small employer note

noCertificate.note: What to withhold when no IL-W-4 is on file is in the IL-W-4 instructions / Publication 130, not supplied.

workedExamples.note: Wage bracket table example; the golden tests use the automated method example.

incomeTax.note: Pay for services is subject to state withholding. Which pre-tax deductions and company contributions reduce or add to withholding wages is not in the supplied documents; paychecks with them are refused until sourced.

unemployment.note: Pay for services is subject to unemployment tax. How pre-tax deductions, tips, reimbursements and company contributions are treated is not in the supplied documents; paychecks with them are refused until sourced.

ownerApproval.scope: Figures checked as copied from the supplied documents, for building and testing the tax calculations. Not a professional review: reviewedBy stays null until a CPA or payroll specialist signs off, which is required before real paychecks.

note: Approved by the product owner for building (see ownerApproval); awaiting professional review.
